body:
This integration branch preserves the incumbent board architecture while developing E16 partition, connectivity, load-service and guarded numerical evidence. It remains **draft, unmerged and unaccepted**; KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT.

Retained implementation includes deterministic KA/KB t2 materialization with separate KB-P1, whole-device current eligibility, bounded feed/source proposals, KA long-B geometric evidence, matched native fill/census admission, and serialized numerical units under unchanged resource controls. These draft studies do not authorize physical adoption or fabrication.

The checkpoint below supersedes stale deferred-status prose in the prior description. Historical descriptions and comments are preserved in [the before-update snapshot](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/b2d830f3748ce6945ffc2a8e5a36714a2effb163/design/partition/core-split/candidates/planning/joined-feed-construction-v2/evidence/e16/numerical-baseline-wsl-20261014/github-pr-before.json.gz), earlier comments, and WORK.md.

---

E16 baseline numerical batch executed once and stopped at the first coupled node-KCL failure. **Numerical batch FAIL; terminal integrity and cleanup PASS.** PR260 stays draft/unmerged; issue253 stays open. KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT.

Evidence commit: `b2d830f3748ce6945ffc2a8e5a36714a2effb163`. Execution HEAD: `0dab96a0fb6434da41765cb181bc8807544f0a7e`. Exact request: `7daa746001d8965891df6135be0b08054e5ca0c7dc9981798429be2919b729e8`; run `19563d44a548466bbe43723a69ece2fe`, attempt3. The owner's actual instruction was recorded using the reviewed approval mechanism. This single-use admission is consumed; no retry, resume or changed request is approved.

[Retained checkpoint, exact command, approval/claim, raw results, versions, hashes and transfer instructions](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/tree/b2d830f3748ce6945ffc2a8e5a36714a2effb163/design/partition/core-split/candidates/planning/joined-feed-construction-v2/evidence/e16/numerical-baseline-wsl-20261014).

**Actual scope:** baseline t2 KA/KB, normal-typ-v1 whole-device subset, +12V / nominal-average / uniform-dielectric only. Nine units passed: service, both reductions, six driving-point chunks (KA275/KB250 pads). The tenth unit, first all-present coupling, failed. The remaining approved nets/cases/states were NOT RUN after the stop. No remedy, native execution, finite regeneration or extra scenario was dispatched.

| Numerical criterion | Actual result | Unchanged limit |
|---|---:|---:|
| KA / KB load reduction residual | 2.98033e-12 / 1.30988e-12 PASS | 1e-9 |
| Interface / reciprocity | Both boards PASS | 1e-9 |
| Six driving-point chunks, worst residual | 2.85081e-10 PASS | 1e-9 |
| Coupled global KCL | 8.34985e-11 PASS | 1e-9 |
| Coupled energy minus load work | 2.48925e-12 PASS | 1e-9 |
| Coupled KA free-node KCL | **1.515200877665821e-8 FAIL** | **1e-9** |
| Coupled KB free-node KCL | **7.277530568849482e-9 FAIL** | **1e-9** |

Nonnegative energy is true; reported wire/terminal imbalance is8.32667e-17A. First failing declared criterion: `all-present.max_free_node_kcl_relative`. Original failed output and numerical verdict are preserved.

**Execution/resources:** exact bound hook exit1 after874.011s. Per-unit shared guard, sequential order, both reductions before driving points,180s/unit and user-systemd2GiB/no-swap remained unchanged. Nine guardPASS receipts; final guardFAIL propagated numerical exit1, not timeout/OOM/environment failure. Nine sampled solver scopes had zero sampled memory events and peak1,717,420,032bytes; all inactive/absent afterward, no workload or guard owner/lock remains. The short service scope was not independently sampled; its CLI self-check and guard receipt are retained.

Before any tracked edit, all337 sealed inputs and550 protected files matched, with request/approval/source/checkout integrity intact. Independent read-only preflight, terminal and compact evidence reviews PASS. Method: separate agent hashing, JSON/gzip parsing, source inspection and OS queries; no reviewer solve, pickle loading or execution. This is evidence-review PASS, not numerical PASS.

**Electrical scope:** service remains151 supported /59 partial /21 unserved /194 unmapped groups,302eligible pads and zero signed included-current residual. The failed coupled state contains116injected +12V pads totaling171.6mA; its voltage/current/resistance figures are provisional. AGND did not run, so no new rail-minus-local-ground or return-removal claim exists. No electrical acceptance.

**Corrected current status:** previously completed WSL control/startup qualification, single oracle unittest, three matched native fill/census reconciliations and finite coverage remain complete in their recorded scopes. They were not repeated. The earlier short +12V reductions also remain PASS. Current full numerical status is now **attempted and stopped on coupled node-KCL FAIL**, replacing “NOT RUN / NOT ADMITTED” for this consumed batch.

Connectivity remains KA-t2 196 /KB-t2 486, separateKB-P1 480 and distinctKA long-B194 unresolved identities. Physical source/protection, complete loads/GH380 currents, full-path resistance, capped DRC enumeration and installed/mechanical/bench qualification remain open. Canonical boards, accepted copper, fixed panel positions and decision.json are unchanged.

Circuit/doc checks, guarded documentation build and strict site check PASS; existing single link exception unchanged. SCOPE: manual68lines, no schematic/placement binding, pin-asset check performed. CI and aggregate/native reruns NOT RUN for this evidence-only `[skip ci]` publication. Eight pickle outputs (50,087,109bytes) remain in original supported WSL cache; all paths/sizes/hashes and transfer instructions are indexed. No PCB/pickle blob or LFS added.

**Next evidence-driven task:** prepare a separately approved isolated +12V reconstruction-residual diagnostic on these preserved inputs. Float64 interface `Y @ v_t` before subtraction from extended-precision `u0` is a plausible precision seam, not proven root cause. Identify worst nodes and separate load, interface, reconstruction and operator residual contributions before proposing a production change. No full-batch retry or tolerance change.
